title: SASHA Terms of Service
intro: These Terms govern authorized access to SASHA, the Studio Intelligence Platform. They are a working draft and must be reviewed by qualified legal counsel before broad commercial release.

sections.title: 1. Eligibility and authority
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old and authorized by the organization whose workspace you access. You represent that the registration and account information you provide is accurate and that you have authority to connect the business systems and data sources you configure.

sections.title: 2. Authorized business use
paragraphs: SASHA may be used only for lawful internal business intelligence, reporting, configuration, and approved automation. You may not attempt to access another organization, interfere with the service, probe security controls, introduce malicious code, or use SASHA to violate law or third-party rights.

sections.title: 3. Accounts and security
paragraphs: Each user must use an individual account, protect login credentials, and promptly report suspected unauthorized access. Organizations are responsible for assigning appropriate roles and studio access. We may suspend access when reasonably necessary to protect users, data, or the service.

sections.title: 4. Connected services
paragraphs: SASHA can connect to third-party systems such as point-of-sale, reservation, messaging, advertising, and analytics platforms. You authorize SASHA to access those systems only within the permissions you grant. Third-party services remain governed by their own terms, availability, and policies.

sections.title: 5. Customer data and communications
paragraphs: Your organization is responsible for having a lawful basis to process customer data and send communications. Automation must be configured and used in compliance with applicable consent, marketing, telecommunications, and consumer-protection requirements. SASHA does not independently determine whether a recipient has consented to a message.

sections.title: 6. Data and platform ownership
paragraphs: Your organization retains its rights in data it supplies or connects. You grant SASHA the limited rights needed to host, process, secure, and present that data to provide the service. SASHA and its licensors retain rights in the platform, software, designs, documentation, and aggregated service improvements that do not identify an organization or individual.

sections.title: 7. Availability and changes
paragraphs: The service may change as features and integrations evolve. We aim to provide reliable service but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. Beta, preview, and browser-automation features may be more susceptible to third-party interface changes.

sections.title: 8. Fees and termination
paragraphs: Any fees, subscription period, and cancellation terms will be stated in the applicable order or subscription agreement. An organization may stop using the service, and we may suspend or terminate access for material breach, security risk, unlawful use, or nonpayment, subject to any controlling agreement.

sections.title: 9. Disclaimers and liability
paragraphs: SASHA provides decision support and does not replace professional, legal, tax, accounting, or financial advice. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the service is provided without implied warranties, and liability limitations will be governed by the final counsel-approved terms and any applicable written agreement.

sections.title: 10. Contact and updates
paragraphs: Material updates will be presented for renewed acceptance. Questions about these Terms should be directed to the support or legal contact published by the service operator.
